name: risk_scoring_calculator
description: Always use this tool at the very end of your audit. Count the number of critical, high, and medium flags you found, and pass them to this tool to calculate the final Risk Score and get the routing recommendation.
schema: [{"id":1,"property":"critical_flags","type":"number","description":"Count of critical risks found (e.g., Blacklisted vendor, Exa news of fraud, Duplicate invoice)","required":true},{"id":2,"property":"high_flags","type":"number","description":"Count of high risks found (e.g., Three-way match failure, GST mismatch, Approval limit violation)","required":true},{"id":3,"property":"medium_flags","type":"number","description":"Count of medium/fuzzy risks found (e.g., Round number anomalies, weekend timing)","required":true}]
